description:
The image depicts a parking meter situated in front of a stone wall, with a body of water visible in the background. The parking meter is black and features a round top with a digital display screen on the left side, accompanied by a slot for inserting coins or payment cards on the right side. The meter is mounted on a sturdy metal pole, which is securely anchored into the ground.

In the background, a stone wall stretches across the width of the image, with a small gap in the center.
